name: moto-garage
description: Moto Garage: buscador de motocicletas con garage personal (React + Express + MongoDB)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
